niece of the Rev. William Bigg Wither

Seventh daughter of Harris Jervoise Bigg Wither (1806-1887) (who had proposed to Jane Austen), she was wife of George Norsworthy and niece of the Rev. W.H.W. Bigg Wither. [Rev. Reginald Bigg-Wither, Materials for a History of the Wither Family (Winchester: Warren & Son 1907)]
